name: slider
title: Minecraft Slider
description: Original Java 26.2 slider track/handle, logical-pixel position rounding, and ASCII labels with standard shadcn/Radix values and events. Native matrix: 225 single-thumb horizontal cases at scales 1–3. Range/RTL/vertical are web extensions.
